methodologyNotes: This dataset covers 13 burr coffee grinders spanning electric espresso, electric filter, and manual categories, selected for high search volume and current availability in 2026. Specs were sourced from manufacturer product pages (Baratza, Fellow, Breville, Eureka, DF64 Coffee, Niche Coffee, 1Zpresso, Comandante, Timemore, OXO) and corroborated via specialty retailers (Clive Coffee, Seattle Coffee Gear, Whole Latte Love, Prima Coffee) and review outlets (The Coffee Folk, Complete Home Barista, Coffeeness). Weights are in pounds (lbs), burr sizes in millimeters, hopper capacity in grams, priceUsd reflects published US MSRP or standard US retail price as verified on live pages 2026-06-19. Adversarial re-verification corrected the Breville Smart Grinder Pro weight (shipping weight had been mislabeled as unit weight), filled the Fellow Opus weight, fixed the Fellow Opus source URL (pointed to the wrong Opus 2 page), and adjusted the 1Zpresso J-Max price to the published Amazon figure. All 13 products are real and verifiable; none were removed.

products.name: Encore ESP
products.provenance: Price $199.95 confirmed live on Baratza official US page (2026-06-19). 40mm Etzinger M2 conical steel burrs, dual-resolution 40-step collar, 8 oz (227g) hopper confirmed via Coffee Bros and Seattle Coffee Gear. Release 2022 (original Encore ESP); a separate Encore ESP Pro launched 2025. Some retailers cite a 2023 retail availability.

products.name: Virtuoso+
products.provenance: Price $249.95 confirmed across Clive Coffee, Seattle Coffee Gear, Williams Sonoma. 40mm conical commercial-grade steel burrs, 40 stepped settings, 8 oz hopper, 7.5-8 lbs weight. Release date is borderline: pre-orders opened April 2019 (CoffeeGeek first look), general availability/launch widely cited as 2020. Kept 2019 per the earliest documented pre-order listing; 2020 is also defensible.

products.name: Ode Brew Grinder Gen 2
products.priceNote: MSRP, Fellow official store and major retailers
products.provenance: Price $399.95, 64mm stainless flat burrs, 31 total steps, 100g single-dose bin, 4.6 kg / 10.14 lbs weight all confirmed live on Fellow official store (2026-06-19) and Clive Coffee. Launched November 2022. Not suitable for espresso per manufacturer.

products.name: Opus Conical Burr Grinder
products.provenance: Original Fellow Opus price $199.95 confirmed via Amazon, Whole Latte Love, Sweet Maria's. 40mm C6-40 Burly Burrs conical, 41 stepped settings plus internal micro-adjust, 110g hopper/ground bin confirmed via Whole Latte Love. Weight corrected from null to 5 lbs (2.27 kg) per Fellow spec and Whole Latte Love/Coffeeness. SOURCE URL FIXED: draft cited fellowproducts.com/products/opus-2-conical-burr-grinder, which is the newer Opus 2 — wrong product for this entry; replaced with the original Opus page (Sweet Maria's). Note a separate Opus 2 (2024) exists with different burr geometry.

products.name: Smart Grinder Pro
products.provenance: Price $199.95 confirmed (Breville US, Best Buy). 60 grind settings, 40mm stainless conical burrs, 1 lb (454g) hopper confirmed across sources. WEIGHT CORRECTED 10 -> 6.4 lbs: the draft used Seattle Coffee Gear's 10.01 lbs which is the SHIPPING weight; actual unit weight is ~6.4 lb / 3 kg per Breville spec sheet and Everything Kitchens. Release year corrected 2013 -> 2014 (BCG820 introduction); model in continuous production.

products.name: DF64 Gen 2 Single Dose Grinder
products.priceNote: Current sale price; regular MSRP $450 on df64coffee.com
products.provenance: Price $399 (sale from $450 MSRP) confirmed live on df64coffee.com (2026-06-19). 64mm stainless flat burrs, stepless adjustment, ~50g bellow capacity, 7.2 kg (~15.8 lbs) weight confirmed on DF64 official store and Turin Grinders. Release ~2022 (successor to Gen 1) per multiple reviews.

products.name: Mignon Specialita
products.priceNote: Representative US MSRP; some retailers list $549-$599
products.provenance: 55mm flat hardened steel burrs, stepless micrometric adjustment, 300g hopper, ~12.3 lbs (5.6kg) confirmed via Clive Coffee, Coffee Bros, Complete Home Barista. Price $449 widely cited as stable US price since 2023 (Complete Home Barista 2026), with some retailers at $549-$599. Release 2018 (introduced HOST 2017).

products.name: J-Max
products.priceNote: Published US Amazon price ~$199; varies $169-$209 by retailer

specs.grind_settings: 90 clicks per rotation (8.8 µm/click), external dial

products.provenance: 48mm titanium-coated conical burrs, 90 clicks/rotation at 8.8 µm/click (external top dial), 35-40g capacity, ~750g (1.7 lbs) all confirmed on The Coffee Folk and 1Zpresso J-series page. PRICE CORRECTED 209 -> 199 to match the published Amazon US figure; retail spans ~$169-$209. Release date not reliably published; kept null.

products.name: C40 MK4 Nitro Blade
products.priceNote: Prima Coffee US price $325 (range $325-$360 by color/retailer)
products.provenance: 39mm outer / 30mm inner conical Nitro Blade burrs (high-alloyed high-nitrogen martensitic steel), 40g bean capacity, 1.63 lbs (740g) weight, price $325 all confirmed live on Prima Coffee (2026-06-19); some US listings/Amazon ~$280, brand store and Prima at $325-$360. Click count ~40/rotation per review sources (not stated on Prima page). Release 2021 (MK4).

products.name: Chestnut C3 ESP Pro
products.priceNote: Current Amazon US price; has dropped to ~$68 on deals
products.provenance: 38mm S2C stainless conical burrs, 30 clicks/circle at 0.0233mm (23.3µm)/click, 20-25g capacity, ~473-530g (1.17 lbs) weight confirmed via Slow Pour Supply comparison and multiple reviews. Price ~$79 (Amazon ASIN B0BZHFYWZD). Release 2022.

products.name: Brew Conical Burr Coffee Grinder
products.priceNote: Current US retail, Seattle Coffee Gear

specs.grind_settings: 15 numbered settings + microsettings (Seattle Coffee Gear lists 42 stepped positions)

products.provenance: Price $109.99, 40mm conical burrs, 12 oz (340g) hopper, 5.6 lbs all confirmed on the cited Seattle Coffee Gear page (2026-06-19). GRIND-SETTINGS CLARIFIED: this standard non-scale model (ASIN B07CSKGLMM) is marketed by OXO as 15 numbered settings plus microsettings; Seattle Coffee Gear (cited source) counts these as '42 stepped' positions. Distinct from the OXO scale model (38-45 settings, $224.99). Weight is SCG shipping weight. Release ~2019.

products.name: Niche Zero
products.priceNote: Current US retail ~$629; range $599-$649 by retailer
products.provenance: 63mm Mazzer Kony hardened-steel conical burrs, stepless dial with 1-50 numbered scale, 4.1 kg (9 lbs) weight, single-dose (no fixed hopper, hence null) all confirmed via Niche official page and The Coffee Folk. Price ~$629 US per Complete Home Barista 2026 price guide; range $599-$649. Indiegogo 2017, retail deliveries 2019.
